address: Yeşilköy mahallesi, Yeşilbahçe Sokak No:9, Bakırköy, Istanbul, 34149, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: This exciting restaurant, reminiscent of a Greek tavern and complete with a lovely terrace, lies just a couple of streets from the marina in Yeşilköy, a residential area on the outskirts of Istanbul with the feel of a seaside resort. The wonderful seafood on display also takes centre stage on the menu, which includes a variety of mezze brimming with Mediterranean zest and beautifully crispy-fried red mullet with skin-on potatoes and a fresh salad. Expect a relaxed dining experience – unpretentious and focused on honest flavours.
